lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters into at least four primary horizontal rows posterior to the 5th gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear regions of higher pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to create a grid-like topology on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper flank characterized by sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradients, originating posterior to the head region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Statistical distribution of high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin's mask shows an irregular but dispersed arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of small high-luminance spots, significantly smaller in pixel-diameter than those observed on the main flank.
